channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay South Block 4 East
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 4 East (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: The City's environmental notice for the project is…
item.description: The City's environmental notice for the project is titled for the block: "The Mission Bay South Block 4 East Project", and describes it as "Mission Bay South Block 4 East, bounded by Mission Rock, Third and China Basin". Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: Notice of Exemption, Planning case 2026-0000027 (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/2026-0000027_The_Mission_Bay_South_Block_4_East_Project.pdf), page 1, Project Title and Project Location (a scanned document).
item.source: Notice of Exemption, Planning case 2026-0000027 (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/2026-0000027_The_Mission_Bay_South_Block_4_East_Project.pdf), page 1, Project Title and Project Location (a scanned document)

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: Curtis Development and Bayview Senior Services are…
item.description: Curtis Development and Bayview Senior Services are the developers; Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P. is the Phase I entity and Mission Bay 4 East Associates 2, L.P. the Phase II entity. The April 2026 Notice of Exemption says all non-manager units "will be dedicated to lower-income households" at no more than 70% of area median income (HUD and TCAC basis), with regulatory agreements to be recorded before building permits; other sources give 30-80% (up to 95%) of MOHCD median income or 35% to about 95%, and these are not reconciled. The $5,000,000 Phase I loan of February 2026 includes $1,943,150.16 already spent under the 2024 predevelopment loan. The tentative parcel map is dated March 31, 2026 and Public Works issued its approval notice on April 2, 2026; neither creates the lots. Construction start and completion dates are expected dates. Source: https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/2026-0000027_The_Mission_Bay_South_Block_4_East_Project.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-08/MEMO_4E%20ENA%20and%20Loan%20Agreement%20with%20Att.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/files/inline-files/2026002.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/files/inline-files/2026004.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: Block 4-East's notes and summary said it sits on a…
item.description: Block 4-East's notes and summary said it sits on a currently active surface parking lot and is administratively separate from the Mission Rock masterplan; no cited document states either, so the first is now labelled an on-site observation and the second was removed. The fronting streets and the roughly 1,253 sq ft retail space are now attributed to the April 2026 Notice of Exemption (the 2025 press article gave 1,280), the 1290 3rd St address to DataSF Parcels, and the Phase I and II construction starts are shown as 2027 and 2028 (Q1 each, per the developer's site) instead of months from a forecast PDF that could not be read. Source: OCII, Notice of Exemption: The Mission Bay South Block 4-East Project, 2026-04-14 (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/2026-0000027_The_Mission_Bay_South_Block_4_East_Project.pdf); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json); Mission Bay 4 East Associates, project site (https://www.mb4e.com/).
item.source: OCII, Notice of Exemption: The Mission Bay South Block 4-East Project, 2026-04-14 (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/2026-0000027_The_Mission_Bay_South_Block_4_East_Project.pdf); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json); Mission Bay 4 East Associates, project site (https://www.mb4e.com/)

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: A CEQA Notice of Exemption is filed for… (Apr 14, 2026)
item.description: A CEQA Notice of Exemption is filed for the Block 4-East project (statutory exemption under AB 1449 / Public Resources Code section 21080.40, the 100%-affordable-housing exemption). The notice states that all residential units "will be dedicated to lower-income households (earning no more than 70% of Area Median Income" on a HUD and TCAC basis, excluding unrestricted manager units, and that the project "is subject to recorded TCAC Regulatory Agreements prior to the issuance of building permits" (future tense: the agreements are to be recorded). Resolution No. 02-2026 gives two manager's units in each phase. (Apr 14, 2026). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-04-14.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-04-14

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: SF Public Works issues notice, on April… (Apr 2, 2026)
item.description: SF Public Works issues notice, on April 2, 2026, of its approval (Public Works Order No. 212730) of Tentative Parcel Map No. 12743 for Block 4-East; the Notice of Exemption does not give the order's own date. The approval is of a tentative map, which does not itself create the lots. The appeal period ended April 12, 2026 with no appeals filed. (Apr 2, 2026). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-04-14.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-04-14

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: Tentative Parcel Map No. 12743 is dated… (Mar 31, 2026)
item.description: Tentative Parcel Map No. 12743 is dated March 31, 2026 (the date on the map, per the Notice of Exemption, not a subdivision event); it proposes to subdivide Assessor Block 8711, Lot 029B into two lots for Phase I and Phase II. It is a tentative map: no final map was found, and DataSF's parcel layer still lists 8711029B as one active lot when queried on 2026-10-12. (Mar 31, 2026). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-04-14.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-04-14

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: OCII Commission Resolution No. 02-2026… (Feb 3, 2026)
item.description: OCII Commission Resolution No. 02-2026 authorizes commitment of approximately $89,600,000 in permanent gap loan funds for Phase I (165 units); the concurrent Resolution No. 03-2026 authorizes a $5,000,000 Phase I predevelopment loan agreement that is "inclusive of $1,943,150.16 in funds expended as of December 16, 2025" under the 2024 predevelopment loan (Exhibit A), so it replaces rather than adds to that spending. Resolution No. 04-2026 (headed "Adopted February 3, 2026") authorizes a $5,000,000 Phase II predevelopment loan to Mission Bay 4 East Associates 2, L.P., likewise inclusive of $1,749,266 spent as of December 16, 2025. (Feb 3, 2026). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03

item.title: Expected · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: Phase I construction start targeted for early… (~2027)
item.description: Phase I construction start targeted for early 2027 (Q1 2027 on the schedule), conditional: the developer's own project site says "Pending financing availability, Phase I of the development—165 apartments—will begin construction in early 2027". OCII's schedule of performance (Exhibit L to Resolution No. 03-2026) lists an estimated Notice to Proceed of February 2027, with a contractual deadline of August 2027. Both are expected dates. (~2027). Source: Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P.; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03.
item.source: Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P.; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03

item.title: Expected · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: Phase II construction start targeted for 2028… (~2028)
item.description: Phase II construction start targeted for 2028 (the developer's own project site: Q1 2028; OCII's schedule of performance, Exhibit L to Resolution No. 04-2026: estimated Notice to Proceed February 2028). Both are expected dates. (~2028). Source: Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P.; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03.
item.source: Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P.; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 4 East: OCII Commission Resolution No. 30-2024… (Sep 3, 2024)
item.description: OCII Commission Resolution No. 30-2024 authorizes the Executive Director to enter into an Exclusive Negotiations Agreement and a Loan Agreement with an affiliate of Curtis Development and Bayview Senior Services, "provid[ing] funding of up to $5,111,731" for predevelopment (as recited in Resolution No. 02-2026; the staff memo recommending it names Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P. as the borrower and gives the ENA term as through September 3, 2027). The $5,111,731 is a ceiling, not money spent. (Sep 3, 2024). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-09-03; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2024-09-03; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2026-02-03
